actions: tutorial:caption:1. Scene Settings: keep the 10-second scene and the Player anchor.
tutorial:caption:Add Subtitle, then set its visible interval in SECONDS.
tutorial:caption:Edit Subtitle opens the text editor. Apply Fields keeps the text.
tutorial:caption:Preview the text at the red playhead. The cards keep their own timing.
tutorial:caption:2. Select the Camera card, then open World positions.
tutorial:caption:Wheel down reduces speed. WASD moves the WORK camera; P records.
tutorial:caption:N creates the next point at the work camera. Existing points stay.
tutorial:caption:Enter applies the position edit. You still need to save the scene.
tutorial:caption:Play previews the camera path together with the subtitle.
tutorial:caption:3. Add Letterbox. Start and End set when the bars are visible.
tutorial:caption:Save As stores the draft as your own scene file.
tutorial:caption:Run Saved asks the server to play the SAVED file.
